DLC2305:3:t_1:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...There are as many forms of justice as there are people... That is precisely why we must believe in our own justice.」

DLC2305:3:t_1:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If that wavers, surely it means our very way of life is wavering too...」

DLC2305:3:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The story I am about to tell takes place two months after $$サイデリアル$$ began its invasion... when its reach began to extend into $$新日本$$.」

DLC2305:3:t_1:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ゼロ$$, commander of the $$新日本$$ volunteer army, sought to gather his former comrades to defend that country.」

DLC2305:3:t_1:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Among them, there was one man he wanted to entrust with command of the front lines.」

DLC2305:3:t_2:4.en:
$$五飛$$
「...I see. So the entire country has become a battlefield...」

DLC2305:3:t_2:5.en:
$$星刻$$
「After crushing the military installations, the $$新地球皇国$$ deploys its troops with almost no regard for population density.」

DLC2305:3:t_2:6.en:
$$星刻$$
「Then it abducts the people from the areas it occupies and builds its bases there... That is the pattern of the Empire's strategy.」

DLC2305:3:t_2:7.en:
$$五飛$$
「$$ターミナル・ベース$$s... Since they're built along the ley lines, they must have something to do with the $$次元力$$ the Earth produces.」

DLC2305:3:t_2:8.en:
$$星刻$$
「$$五飛$$... Do you still intend to keep fighting there?」

DLC2305:3:t_2:9.en:
$$五飛$$
「...This is where I took refuge after $$トレーズ$$ defeated me during the $$再世戦争$$.」

DLC2305:3:t_2:10.en:
$$五飛$$
「I owe them a debt for reminding me of my will to fight.」

DLC2305:3:t_2:11.en:
$$星刻$$
「But the world needs your strength.」

DLC2305:3:t_2:13.en:
$$星刻$$
「No... I'm the one who should apologize for asking too much. Your justice is yours to decide.」

DLC2305:3:t_2:14.en:
$$星刻$$
「My friend, $$五飛$$... I pray for your safety and success.」

DLC2305:3:t_2:16.en:
$$セイナ$$
「Even $$黎星刻$$, the man called the Tiger of the $$中華連邦$$, seems to be struggling.」

DLC2305:3:t_2:17.en:
$$サリィ$$
「Still, the fact that he's holding the southern front shows how capable he is.」

DLC2305:3:t_2:21.en:
$$セイナ$$
「Is that any way to talk to us? We're the deputy commander and strategist of the resistance group you lead.」

DLC2305:3:t_2:24.en:
$$五飛$$
「This discussion is over. They're here.」

DLC2305:3:t_2:25.en:
$$サリィ$$
「They've failed to take this remote village several times. They'll probably send a large force this time.」

DLC2305:3:t_2:27.en:
$$五飛$$
「We'll follow the plan we made. $$サリィ$$, gather the villagers. $$セイナ$$, you and the others will escort them.」

DLC2305:3:t_2:28.en:
$$セイナ$$
「What are you going to do?」

DLC2305:3:t_3:5.en:
$$セイナ$$
「You have nothing to apologize for.」

DLC2305:3:t_3:6.en:
$$サリィ$$
「Japan is the only place that has repelled the Empire's attacks... It will play a vital role in the counteroffensive to come.」

DLC2305:3:t_3:7.en:
$$サリィ$$
「But that's largely thanks to the $$新日本$$ volunteer army led by $$ゼロ$$ stopping the Empire's advance.」

DLC2305:3:t_3:8.en:
$$五飛$$
「Sooner or later, the Empire will send even more forces to conquer $$新日本$$...」

DLC2305:3:t_3:9.en:
$$五飛$$
「It seems $$ゼロ$$ is gathering troops to prepare for that.」

DLC2305:3:t_3:10.en:
$$サリィ$$
「Leave things here to us. We've already found somewhere for the villagers to go.」

DLC2305:3:t_3:11.en:
$$セイナ$$
「$$新日本$$ is our home, the home of $$Ａ２１$$. Make sure you protect it, $$五飛$$.」

DLC2305:3:t_3:13.en:
$$デュオ$$
「They really were counting on $$五飛$$.」

DLC2305:3:t_3:14.en:
$$トロワ$$
「That must be exactly why $$ゼロ$$ needs him too.」

DLC2305:3:t_3:15.en:
$$カトル$$
「Our objective is complete. Let's return to $$新日本$$ at once.」

DLC2305:3:t_3:16.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「$$五飛$$, $$ゼロ$$... $$トレーズ$$'s soul lives on within them...」

DLC2305:3:t_3:17.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$ゼクス$$... The same goes for you.」

DLC2305:3:t_3:19.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「I've chosen to go on fighting, even if it means living in disgrace. In part, that is to carry on the will of the man who made his death a foundation for peace.」

DLC2305:3:t_3:20.en:
$$五飛$$
「For that, I will risk my life...」

DLC2305:3:t_3:21.en:
$$五飛$$
「And I will choose where I die.」

DLC2305:3:t_3:23.en:
$$五飛$$
「$$新日本$$... That will be my new battlefield.」

DLC2305:3:t_3:24.en:
$$五飛$$
（$$トレーズ$$... I will live and keep fighting.）

DLC2305:3:t_3:25.en:
$$五飛$$
（Believing that is the only way to surpass you, now that you're dead...）

DLC2305:3:t_3:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...A tiger leaves its hide in death, and $$トレーズ$$ Khushrenada leaves his justice...」

DLC2305:3:t_3:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The heroic death of one man lives on in this world, still influencing so many people.」

DLC2305:3:t_3:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Those who carry on his will... They will continue fighting for their own forms of justice...」

DLC2305:4:t_001:0.en:
$$サリィ$$
「The $$マリーメイア$$ Army's mobile suits...!」

DLC2305:4:t_001:1.en:
$$セイナ$$
「It looks like the Empire is using them.」

DLC2305:4:t_001:2.en:
$$五飛$$
「I'll hold them off! I'm counting on you to get the villagers out, $$セイナ$$!」

DLC2305:4:t_001:4.en:
$$Ａ２１$$
「Wait, Deputy Commander! I'm staying with Commander $$五飛$$ too!」

DLC2305:4:t_001:5.en:
$$Ａ２１$$
「Even the Commander can't do this with just one machine!」

DLC2305:4:t_001:6.en:
$$五飛$$
「Those words alone are like having ten thousand allies at my side.」

DLC2305:4:t_001:8.en:
$$五飛$$
「You've found your own battle. Don't let it end here.」

DLC2305:4:t_001:10.en:
$$五飛$$
「Let me make this clear. I don't intend to die here.」

DLC2305:4:t_001:11.en:
$$五飛$$
「There will be no peace until the Empire is defeated. My battle will continue until then.」

DLC2305:4:t_001:13.en:
$$Ａ２１$$
「We'll protect the villagers, no matter what. So don't you die either.」

DLC2305:4:t_001:14.en:
$$セイナ$$
「Let's go, everyone. We can't let $$五飛$$'s battle be for nothing.」

DLC2305:4:t_003:0.en:
$$五飛$$
「Come, invaders! We've abandoned that village, but you will never have our souls!」

DLC2305:4:t_003:1.en:
$$五飛$$
「I've taken on the villagers' will to fight! And I'll show it to you!」

review.context: Xingke tries to recruit Wufei from the village that once sheltered him. Wufei initially stays out of gratitude, then evacuates its residents and later agrees to join Zero's defense of New Japan, carrying Treize's legacy.
decisions: Zero here is Lelouch's identity, never the Wing Zero system.
Wufei's sentence cut between rows remains 'I...' then 'Will fight. That's all.' to match its source boundary.
Resistance is generic prose here rather than the glossary's person label.
Treize's full surname is Khushrenada; the existing Treize token supplies the first name.
The tiger proverb links the survival of Treize's ideals to a tiger's surviving hide.
Caption repair preserves the source blank header, blank lines, indentation and fullwidth wave decorations; the translated location remains in the body.
